reason: A Tauri-based Windows desktop shell for DeepSeek Harness that integrates the dsh web UI with native windows, tray controls, theme synchronization, state persistence, side panels, and system notifications.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的 dsh Web UI 封装为 Windows 原生桌面应用，并提供托盘、主题同步、窗口状态记忆、侧栏和系统通知功能。
summaries.en: Wraps the DeepSeek Harness dsh web UI in a native Windows desktop application with tray controls, theme synchronization, window-state persistence, side panels, and system notifications.

capabilities: Runs a native Windows desktop shell using Tauri
Starts and manages a local dsh web process and private Node runtime
Persists window, theme, tray, session pin, and plugin configuration locally
Displays system tray items, native notifications, and notification sounds
Downloads runtime and package dependencies during installation
